[P1] Preserve early-completion progress during child serialization

`stopAcceptingChildCheckpoints()` waits for every existing read reservation, but each reservation spans customer SerDes and synchronous checkpoint I/O. With early-completion policies, a slow or blocked losing branch therefore prevents the parent checkpoint and `map()`/`parallel()` return; a stage waiting for handler code after that return deadlocks permanently. Close admission without waiting on unbounded serialization, or make in-flight publication cancellation-aware, and add a regression where post-`get()` code releases a blocked losing branch.
